references.text: Moses exhorts the people to keep the statutes and laws that the Lord has given them
Moses calls Israel together to hear the statutes and laws they are to keep
The commandments, statutes, and laws that Israel is to keep in the promised land all their days
To keep the Lord's statutes so as to live long in the land the Lord gives them
Israel is to take possession of the land the Lord gives them and keep all the statutes and laws
The statutes and laws that the Lord gave Israel through Moses
Israel is to keep all the commandments in order to enter the land the Lord promised their fathers
The Lord's promise to Abraham to give the land to his descendants
The people are to learn to fear the Lord all the days they live on earth
The psalmist's commitment to keep the Lord's statutes forever
